scope: Tracked public-candidate information derived from historical Ansys solver executions
review_unit_policy: One domain solver-run corpus is the minimum upstream review unit. Its source_fingerprint binds the review to the sorted relative paths and SHA-256 hashes of canonical UTF-8/LF JSON content selected by source_paths. Any added, removed, renamed, or changed source requires re-review and a new fingerprint. Legal status and maintainer publication decision remain separate; split a unit when its facts differ.
